name: Empty State
hint: Change the seed for a new scene; switch the theme and it follows.
description: Generated illustration, one sentence of why, and one clear next action. The illustration is drawn from theme tokens and a seed, so it matches every theme and each seed scatters its own shapes.
intents: no projects yet first run screen
usage: Say why it's empty and give exactly one primary action. Pass `title`, `description`, `actionLabel` with `onAction` (and optionally `secondaryLabel` with `onSecondary`); a label left empty draws no button. Pick the drawn scene with `kind`, or pass your own `illustration` or a small `icon`. For no search results, put the user's query in the title.

keyboard.does: Runs the focused action: the main button or the secondary link.

screenReader: A section named by its title, a heading at `headingLevel` (h3 by default), followed by the description and the action buttons in reading order. The drawn scene, the `icon` tile and a custom `illustration` are hidden from assistive technology, so any words they carry belong in the title or description.

dataProps.description: Heading: what is empty. Blank draws no heading.
One or two sentences of why, and what happens next. Blank draws none.
Primary button text. Empty draws no button.
Secondary link-style button text. Empty draws none.
(event) => void, primary button. It runs in the click, so it can open a file picker (inputRef.current.click()).
Icon inside the primary button. None by default.
Your own art in place of the drawn scene (an , an
A small icon in a rounded tile in place of the drawn scene, for compact panels.
Extra content under the actions (a hidden file input with a label, a help link, a shortcut hint).
Heading element level for the title (1 to 6).
The primary action is running: the button shows a spinner and will not fire again until you clear it.
Fill blank title, description and labels with sample copy for the kind, plus the kind's action icon. Gallery only; leave off in real UI.
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <section>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<EmptyState
  kind="search"
  title={`No invoices match “${query}”`}
  description="Search looks at the customer, the number and the amount."
  actionLabel="Clear search"
  onAction={() => setQuery("")}
  secondaryLabel="Show all invoices"
  onSecondary={showAll}
/>
